summary: Solid Phase 1 pass with correct geometry, a complete decorative control inventory, and a dependable synthesized piano voice backed by real audio tests. The six-section layout, 54/46 deck/keybed split, 73-key E1–E7 keybed, and Program/Synth-only OLED placement match the spec. Visual fidelity is functional but schematic: controls render as generic CSS sliders/buttons rather than reference-faithful Nord hardware, and narrow viewports hide section headers below 480px. All four technical gates pass (26/26 tests); capture harness reports zero console errors at 1440×900 and 390×844.

criteria.label: Silhouette, chassis, and geometry
evidence: Candidate audit and hardware tests confirm 54/46 deck/keybed split and six sections at 13/21/15/9/21/21% in the documented order.
73-key E1–E7 keybed (43 white / 30 black, 61% black-key height) rendered on a continuous red chassis with end cheeks; desktop capture fills ~97% viewport width with no scroll.
Chassis uses variant aspect ratio 3.095 via `min(97vw, calc(97vh * 3.095))`; silhouette reads as a Stage 4 study but lacks photo-exact rails, branding placement, and micro-geometry.

criteria.label: Complete hardware inventory and placement
evidence: 163 panel controls with stable `data-control-id` values; hardware model tests assert ≥140 unique IDs, nine organ drawbars, performance wheels, and eight program buttons.

Primary OLED displays exist only in Program ('Init Program') and Synth ('Init Synth') sections; organ drawbar LED ladders, piano type selectors, effects matrix, and synth oscillator/filter groups are present as landmarks.
Controls use responsive flex-wrap grids rather than photo-exact absolute coordinates; density and grouping are credible but not reference-traced.

criteria.label: Materials, color, typography, and displays
evidence: Desktop capture shows simplified flat CSS controls (gray slider tracks, white rectangular buttons) on a red deck — the material family is recognizable but far from the reference's dark inset panels, indexed knobs, LED ladders, and condensed legends.
Section titles are generic uppercase labels; Nord logotype, tan pitch stick, green LED states, and blue-green OLED typography from the reference photo are absent or approximated.
Candidate audit documents intentional simplification of knob/fader industrial design and micro-typography.

criteria.label: Narrow retention
evidence: Narrow capture at 390×844 completes with zero page errors and zero console messages; chassis and all 73 keys remain on-screen.
CSS hides section headers and control captions below 480px to prevent clipping — instrument is inspectable but panel legends are largely illegible at narrow width.
Candidate uses a slightly taller narrow aspect (3.095/1.15) to preserve keybed legibility; structure retained but 'legible state' is only partially met.

criteria.label: Unified playable inputs
evidence: Keybed tests cover pointer down/up/cancel and keyboard focus; engine tests exercise computer-key mapping with repeat suppression (`KeyA` held twice → one pressed note).
Injectable `createMockMidiPort` drives note-on/note-off and CC64 sustain through the shared `NoteLifecycle`; MIDI denied/disconnected paths are implemented in `src/input/midi.ts`.
Status strip reports 'Piano: ready · Voices: 0' after load; all input sources route through one lifecycle controller.

criteria.label: Voice lifecycle and performance
evidence: Engine tests verify note start/release cleanup, repeated/overlapping notes on one key, and `allNotesOff` clearing every voice.
Sustain tests hold voices after key release and release on pedal up; polyphony test fills 33 notes and asserts deterministic oldest-voice stealing at limit 32.
Velocity scaling and blur/disconnect cleanup are covered in engine tests with injectable timing boundaries.

criteria.label: Basic source and status honesty
evidence: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json truthfully declares Phase 1 additive synthesis (triangle + sine overtone, AD envelope) with zero sample sources.
Verification digest confirms `sampleSources: 0` and generated strategy text matches the JSON.
Phase 1 scope allows a declared synthesis voice; no fake sample claims.

criteria.label: Control movement and feedback
evidence: Every panel control type (knob, fader, drawbar, button, wheel, display) is modeled in `CONTROLS` with accessible names and section ownership.
Keybed tests assert aria-pressed state on pointer interaction; decorative control movement updates presentation state in the hardware model.
163 controls respond to pointer and keyboard activation without breaking layout.

criteria.label: Decorative-control boundary
evidence: Phase 1 contract excludes panel audio/system changes; only keybed notes and sustain input are functional.
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS and status strip scope panel controls as visual-only for this phase.
No panel knob/button tests assert audio graph mutation — decorative boundary is honest.

criteria.label: Data structure and tests
evidence: Normalized typed hardware model (`src/model/hardware.ts`) with stable IDs; keyboard geometry in `src/model/keyboard.ts`.
Feature matrix maps all 11 Phase 1 IDs to five non-empty test files; verification confirms 11/11 coverage.
Injectable audio/MIDI/timing boundaries in `src/audio/boundaries.ts` keep tests deterministic without network or devices.

criteria.label: Runtime quality
evidence: Sealed verification: test/typecheck/lint/build all passed; 26/26 tests in ~2.9s.
Playwright capture reports zero console messages and zero page errors at desktop and narrow profiles.
Production build produces `dist/index.html` (211 KB JS bundle); preview at `/previews/composer-2-5-fast/stage1/index.html`.

issues.description: Panel controls use simplified CSS primitives instead of reference-faithful Nord hardware styling; materials/typography score capped accordingly.
Narrow viewport hides section headers and control captions below 480px; structure retained but legends are not legible at 390×844.
